_meta.task: T-70 pilot criteria-2 blind code-quality scoring (primary evaluator face)
_meta.evaluator: cloud GM (primary, per RUBRIC §2.3); auxiliary qwen2.5:14b NOT performed this batch (optional face, honest disclosure)
_meta.protocol: absolute-anchor integer scores 1-10 (not comparative); each file scored immediately on read, sibling of same task not compared during scoring; no code executed (criteria-1 functional face closed separately by frozen verify commands); mask map NOT read before or during scoring
_meta.pre_scoring_integrity: 20/20 masked file sha256 == MANIFEST entries (verified before scoring); .mask_map.json gitignored and untracked at scoring time
